purpose: The B3 pre-authorization (Phase 3D-5, Issue #24) checks of the one-installation allowance, with the exact test identifiers that exercise them. Every test is DEVELOPER-AUTHORED and uses synthetic bytes or no file at all; none of them is independent evidence by itself. tools/run_staging.py --manifest <this file> runs exactly these identifiers and fails if one is missing, renamed, ignored or failing. The real jq bytes are never read, copied, hashed or executed by any of them.

requirements.title: The one-installation allowance is a durable state machine bound to recipe, artifact, computer and data directory; damaged, edited, foreign and contradicted records are invalid; no reset path exists
One installation survives a restart; a removal or a second preview/confirmation cannot reopen it; a stale offer cannot use a spent allowance
Eight services with independent consent books race for the one installation: exactly one wins
Interrupted transactions: a crash at any point ends installed-and-consumed or unresolved, never open; roll-forward settles from the receipt; a release needs its audit row
Corrupted, missing, forged, foreign state and missing/altered receipts fail closed (needs_attention) and are never repaired
Bound to one recipe, artifact and data directory; inactive until armed; the unlocked-but-inactive B3 activation candidate, an inactive or spent pilot never ask the provider for a byte
The allowance module has no reset path, credential framework, process, network or environment access

Phase 3D-6 arming: the allowance is armed for ONE data directory (a scope digest, never a path); no ordinary location matches it; the real supply is bound to the reviewed pilot and refuses every other data directory before it reads a byte

notReproducibleInCi: The real application window of the candidate build (tools/gui_jq_pilot_locked.ps1): needs WebView2 and a desktop session.
Smart App Control / Defender reaction to a real executable: never part of this phase.
Operating-system level network isolation: not available without administrator rights.
